Skipped already-published Tom Cruise BAFTA, Eran Dinur, Lightstorm-Outsyders, After Effects AI assistant, Disney CTO (exec move), Danny Boyle Ink (stale). Section fresh AI news thin; pool is 12. Dup pairs: Variety Hazanavicius / Deadline San Sebastian.

items.headline: Goodfellas' Vincent Maraval Says Michel Hazanavicius Cut Eight Days of Production on 'The Third Hand' by Using AI
items.excerpt: At San Sebastian's Creative Investors' Conference, Goodfellas CEO Vincent Maraval said AI turned a ten-day shoot for a major WWI scene in Hazanavicius' 'The Third Hand' into two days, arguing AI can expand filmmakers' creativity.

items.headline: Creative Risks, AI & Brazil's Production Boom: Day One of the 2026 San Sebastian Creative Investors' Conference
items.excerpt: Deadline's day-one recap of San Sebastian's investor conference, including Maraval's claim that Goodfellas' back office runs largely on AI and that AI replaced eight shooting days on 'The Third Hand'. NOTE: same story as the Variety Hazanavicius item; pick one.

items.headline: Generative AI, Microdramas to Take Center Stage at Busan Market
items.excerpt: Busan's Asian Contents & Film Market InnoAsia strand runs 11 programs led by generative AI, including a Kling AI session on reimagining filmmaking and an Eyeline talk on generative AI in production. NOTE: an earlier Variety InnoAsia/DeepMind-AWS story was already published; this is the full program follow-up.

items.headline: Robin Williams' Daughter Calls for Fans Creating AI Videos of the Actor to 'Have Some Shame'
items.excerpt: Zelda Williams again called on fans to stop circulating AI-generated videos of her late father, reigniting the debate over AI likeness of deceased performers. NOTE: a similar Robin Williams AI-slop story ran earlier.

items.headline: Duncan Jones on Why It's 'Harder Than Ever' to Make His Kind of Movies (and Why He Refused to Use AI for His Newest One)
items.excerpt: The 'Moon' director explains how his decade-long animated 'Rogue Trooper' adaptation got made and why he refused to use generative AI as a shortcut in its animation pipeline.

items.headline: MIPCOM in Cannes Bets on Creators, Brands & AI
items.excerpt: MIPCOM launches a new MIP AI Entertainment Forum conference and market with Versos AI and Protege, as organizer Lucy Smith repositions the Cannes market around creators, branded content and AI.

items.headline: Microdrama Producers Voice Cautious Optimism on the Sector Despite AI Worries
items.excerpt: Producers of vertical microdramas debated whether a flood of AI-generated titles and China's generative-AI push threaten the format, arguing human actors, writers and directors still bring energy AI tools can't.

items.headline: CaptionX Clips for Turning Long Videos Into Shorts
items.excerpt: AI captioning maker CaptionX launched Clips, which analyzes a long video or podcast and returns ranked, self-contained short moments ready to publish.

items.headline: Insta360 X6 turns 360 video into explorable 3D scenes
items.excerpt: Insta360's Spatial Capture converts 360 footage into Gaussian-splat (3DGS) scenes via cloud processing, rolling out in the US on Sept 28 with four free scenes per month. NOTE: body describes 3DGS, not 'AI' explicitly.

items.headline: Why a Gaussian 'splat' helps lighting — go 3D+2D, not all-3D
items.excerpt: fxguide breaks down how Gaussian splats, generative video models and traditional 3D exports can be combined for lighting, FX and production control.

items.headline: Seedance 2.5 Just Got a Load of Awesome New Features!
items.excerpt: Dreamina's Seedance 2.5 canvas overhaul adds an AI agent that plans and organizes a shoot, an Elements library that carries characters and voices across prompts, new Skills, and MiniMax H3, GPT Image 2 and Nano Banana Pro inside the canvas.

items.headline: Camera Angles Are Becoming a Thing of the Past
items.excerpt: Curious Refuge tests three AI methods for generating new camera angles from existing shots, with a written breakdown and prompts.
